had only been with Three Shires for 6 months when I opted to move to another local surgery.  In this time, I was laughed at by the never-present  receptionist staff and, rather than actually providing beneficial treatment, the doctors I dealt with there exacerbated my stress and anxiety. Treatments requested by my heart specialist at the BRI were battled against for MONTHS and were never administered, private & confidential information divulged to a doctor was passed to a third party against my express wishes and for daring to speak to the doctor in question as they left work, I was then sent me a written warning just days after my father died stating I’d acted inappropriately and been threatening. (I’m a completely non-aggressive 50 year old gay man)

All in all, this surgery seems to be run by people who value their own egos above actual patient care and, to whom the hypocritic oath is optional.
